changelog: ⚡ Fixed player interval accumulation and memory leak in lifecycle teardown
🛡️ Memory-safe Hls.js adaptive buffers preventing low-RAM device stutters
🚀 Resolved React ErrorBoundary crashes across media rail views
🍿 Ultra-smooth buffer-free streaming across movies, serials, and live channels
🔥 100% Zero-Freeze Fire TV Stability: Eliminated software decoder CPU stall trap that locked up Fire TV sticks
⚡ Flawless Resume & Continue Watching: Preserved playback position on remote Back key and Exit Player
🛡️ Stream Stability: Stopped premature stream failovers caused by blocked ad trackers in web video views
🌐 Native DASH (.mpd) Support: Added ExoPlayer DashMediaSource module for broader stream compatibility
🎮 TV Remote Navigation: Remote Back key now cleanly exits app on Home tab, and ErrorBoundary has full D-pad recovery controls
🧹 Memory & Resource Hardening: Shared singleton OkHttpClient and enabled largeHeap + WAKE_LOCK
